# Switch NX2 - read when the Hortensia GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1
# Size the temporary ASTC decode images exactly (=0) instead of rounding them up to a multiple of 64
# texels so textures of nearly the same size share one.
#EDEN_NX2_ASTC_SCRATCH_BUCKET=0
# Submit after the ASTC decode (=0) instead of recording the decode and the BC encode in one submit.
#EDEN_NX2_ASTC_ONE_SUBMIT=0
# Only move finished ASTC decode images back to the pool once a frame, and drop the newest one when
# the pool is full (=0), instead of when a texture asks for one and evicting the oldest.
#EDEN_NX2_ASTC_POOL_V2=0
# Only reuse an ASTC decode image of exactly the size asked for (=0), not a larger one.
#EDEN_NX2_ASTC_POOL_FIT=0

# Log FPS stats (average, min, max, 1% low) every 5 seconds and a session summary on close.
# Enabled by default. Set to 0 to disable.
#EDEN_FPS_LOG=0

# Force Mario Kart World swap interval (default is 1 to prevent 30 fps cap when dynamic FPS is off).
#EDEN_NX2_MKW_SWAP_INTERVAL=2

# Force Donkey Kong Bananza swap interval (default is 1 to prevent 30 fps cap when dynamic FPS is off).
#EDEN_NX2_DK_SWAP_INTERVAL=2

# Pin split GPU front/back threads to dedicated physical cores (default on for 6+ physical cores; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_NX2_PIN_THREADS=0

# Keep time-critical threads on P-cores of hybrid CPUs on Windows (default on; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_HYBRID_CORES=0

# Spin briefly in microseconds before parking Switch 2 guest CPU threads (default 50; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_NX2_IDLE_SPIN_US=50

# Skip re-scanning buffer ranges whose 4 MiB memory tracker region has had no CPU write since the last sync (default on; set to 0 to always scan).
#EDEN_NX2_SYNC_SKIP=0

# Read large (>= 64 KiB) linear texture uploads from guest memory on the Vulkan worker thread (default on; set to 0 to read on the GPU thread).
#EDEN_NX2_DEFER_UPLOADS=0

# Keep CurrentGraphicsPipeline when no pipeline-relevant Maxwell3D register has changed (default on; set to 0 to always refresh, or verify to audit).
#EDEN_NX2_PIPELINE_SKIP=0

# Skip Pokemon Pokopia's far shadow cascade draws to save ~17% GPU thread work in town (default on for Pokopia; set to 1 to keep far cascade).
#EDEN_NX2_SHADOW_FAR=1

# Replace Ocarina of Time's 11-pass title movie neural network with a direct surface copy (default on; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_NX2_UPSCALE_REPLACE=0

# Report Variable Refresh Rate (VRR) display capability to Switch 2 SDKs (disabled by default for Mario Kart World; set to 1 to force on or 0 to disable).
#EDEN_NX2_REPORT_VRR=0

# Donkey Kong Bananza: Lock to solid 30 FPS swap interval (interval 2) to prevent uneven 1/2/3 interval pacing spikes (default off; set to 1 to enable).
#EDEN_NX2_DK_30FPS=1

# Mario Kart World: run cup intro movies at unpaced full speed (default on; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_MKW_MOVIE_UNPACED=0

# AMD proprietary driver: build crashing/stalling shaders without driver optimizations (default on; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_NX2_AMD_SAFE_COMPILE=0
#EDEN_NX2_AMD_SAFE_COMPILE_GRAPHICS=1

# Pokopia: flush accelerated DMA image-to-buffer copies to guest memory to prevent banded/striped photos (default on; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_NX2_DMA_READBACK_FLUSH=0

# Vulkan pipeline preloading: asynchronously pre-build recorded pipelines in background workers at boot (Selevet port, default on; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_NX2_PIPELINE_PRELOAD=0

# Switch 2 Ampere tensor emulation: synthesize Maxwell collective TENSOR_MUL_ADD for HMMA compute shaders (Splatoon, DK, etc.; default on; set to 0 to disable).
#EDEN_NX2_TENSOR=0

# Donkey Kong Bananza: cap framerate to 60 FPS in PaceToVblank (default on; set to 0 to allow uncapped framerates).
#EDEN_NX2_DK_60FPS=0
